title: dora-register-entry
description: Structured DORA Register of Information output. Mirrors the EBA-developed Implementing Technical Standard adopted by the Commission Implementing Regulation (the table identifiers below follow the EBA preparation materials' B.01 to B.07 convention; the exact table codes and column codes in the adopted ITS are flagged [verify ITS] in references/source-anchors.md and resolved at firm onboarding). Top-level container holds register metadata, the in-scope financial entities, the relational table records, the firm's own data-quality findings, reconciliations, open questions, reviewer questions, and a source trace. Downstream consumers: concentration-risk-review (reads ICT third-party providers and sub-contractor records), exit-plan (reads critical-or-important function records), supervisory submission pipeline (consumes the per-table records).

register_id.description: Stable identifier for the register submission (firm-defined, e.g., '<group-LEI>-<reporting-year>').

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which the register build was produced.

as_of_date.description: Reporting reference date for the register. The ITS specifies the reference date convention; consult the adopted Commission Implementing Regulation.

reporting_reference_period_start.description: Start of the reporting reference period.

reporting_reference_period_end.description: End of the reporting reference period.

national_competent_authority_code.description: Code for the national competent authority receiving the submission. Use the NCA reference value in the ITS taxonomy where defined.

consolidation_level.description: Level at which the register is reported.

reporting_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary amounts in the register.

build_review_type.description: Why this register build is being produced. Drives depth and reviewer-question set.

source_data_posture.description: Which firm systems and registers were used as input, and the data-quality caveats.

entities_in_scope.description: Legal entities of the financial-entity group covered by this register.

tables.description: Per-table records aligned to the EBA Register of Information ITS. Table identifiers follow the B.01 to B.07 convention from the EBA preparation materials; the adopted ITS column codes must be confirmed at firm onboarding (see references/source-anchors.md).

b_01_contractual_arrangements_general.description: [verify ITS table code] Contractual arrangements — general information. One record per contractual arrangement.

b_02_contractual_arrangements_specific.description: [verify ITS table code] Contractual arrangements — specific information linking arrangements to ICT services and ICT third-party service providers; intra-group flag.

b_03_ict_third_party_service_providers.description: [verify ITS table code] ICT third-party service providers. One record per provider.

b_04_functions.description: [verify ITS table code] Functions of the financial entity supported by ICT services, with criticality classification.

b_05_ict_services.description: [verify ITS table code] ICT services supplied under contractual arrangements, including ICT-service-type code from the ITS taxonomy.

b_06_sub_contractors_chain.description: [verify ITS table code] Sub-contractor chain for ICT services supporting critical or important functions.

b_07_entities_signing_or_making_use.description: [verify ITS table code] Entities of the financial-entity group signing the arrangement or making use of the ICT services.

data_quality_findings.description: The firm's own quality view of the register. Supervisors expect the firm to know its own gaps.

reconciliations.description: Reconciliations against the firm's existing TPRM register, ICT-asset inventory, contract repository, and prior-year register.

open_questions.description: Open legal, compliance, or interpretation questions surfaced by the build. Each item names the function the question goes to.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the human approver. Each question names the decision it supports.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates the register submission must clear before filing.

owner.description: Role responsible for the register build. Examples: head of TPRM, ICT risk manager, DORA programme lead.

approver.description: Role of the accountable executive named in the firm's DORA governance for register submission.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the build, per references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims and data-source provenance for the register entries.

contractual_arrangement_reference_number.description: Firm-internal unique reference for the contractual arrangement.

type_of_arrangement.description: [verify ITS column code] Type of contractual arrangement.

linked_arrangement_references.description: Other arrangement reference numbers linked to this arrangement (e.g., master and addenda chain).

ict_third_party_identifier.description: LEI or other ITS-defined identifier for the ICT third-party service provider party to this arrangement.

ict_service_identifier_links.description: ICT service identifiers (b_05) covered by this arrangement.

intra_group_flag.description: [verify ITS column code] True where the ICT third party is part of the financial entity's group. Intra-group arrangements remain reportable but are flagged.

linked_function_references.description: Function references (b_04) supported by this arrangement.

provider_identifier.description: LEI preferred. Where LEI is unavailable, EUID or national identifier; the type is recorded in identifier_type. Missing identifiers are a data-quality finding.

provider_type.description: Free text or ITS-coded provider type (e.g., cloud-service-provider, software-vendor, data-vendor, managed-service-provider).

designated_as_critical_by_competent_auth.description: [verify ITS column code] True where designated as a Critical ICT Third-Party Service Provider under DORA Article 31 oversight framework.

eu_presence_flag.description: True where the provider has an EU establishment relevant for the arrangement.

function_reference.description: Firm-internal reference for the function supported by the ICT service.

criticality.description: Sourced from criticality-assessment. The DORA register consumes the determination; it does not set it.

criticality_evidence_record_id.description: Pointer to the criticality-assessment record supporting the determination. Required to back the flag.

ict_service_identifier.description: Firm-internal unique identifier for the ICT service.

ict_service_type_code.description: [verify ITS taxonomy] ICT-service-type code from the ITS-defined taxonomy. Map firm-internal service-type taxonomy to this; record the mapping decisions.

location_of_data_at_rest.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for data-at-rest locations.

location_of_data_processing.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for data-processing locations.

parent_ict_third_party_identifier.description: Identifier of the upstream ICT third-party service provider in the chain.

role_in_chain.description: [verify ITS column code] Whether the sub-contractor provides the actual service or sits as intermediary.

supports_critical_or_important_function.description: Sub-contractor visibility is required for ICT services supporting critical or important functions; missing entries are a finding.

rank_in_chain.description: Position in the sub-contractor chain (1 = direct sub-contractor of the contracted ICT third party).

entity_lei_or_identifier.description: LEI or ITS-defined identifier of the financial-entity group entity making use of the ICT services.
